segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: I might take the job in Berlin.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Were I in your position, I'd think hard about it.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Had I known earlier, I'd have prepared better.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: But for your German, it'd be impossible anyway.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Should you hear of anything, let me know.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Had she asked, I'd have helped.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Should it rain, we'll move inside.
